newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain 91-day t-bill yield slips to 5.69 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain 91-day t-bill yield slips to 5.69 percent.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills decreased to 5.69 percent from 5.72 percent last week, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price climbed to 98.582 from 98.575 last week while the minimum price accepted was 98.552.
Banks submitted bids for 21.82 million dinars worth of bills, down from 22 million dinars the previous week.
The bills, maturing on October 15, were offered on Monday and would be issued on Wednesday. -- Bahrain newsroom +973 524424
